title: Common questions about NSW Digital ID
summary: This page provides information about the NSW Digital ID, including how it works, when you can use it, and how your data is protected.
what_you_need: To set up your NSW Digital ID, you must log in to your MyServiceNSW Account, go to Manage, go to Settings, and select NSW Digital ID.

external_links.text: link your toll account to claim the toll relief rebate online

faqs.a: NSW Digital ID is a secure way to prove who you are online, allowing you to access services and information from NSW Government websites.

faqs.q: When can I use NSW Digital ID?
faqs.a: You can use NSW Digital ID when accessing various NSW Government services online, provided the service supports it.

faqs.q: How is my personal information protected?
faqs.a: Your data is protected by NSW Government security standards. Access to your personal information is strictly controlled and only used for the specific service you are accessing.
